cc:Work.dc:title: Equal-work model sensitivity
cc:Work.dc:description: Hypothetical ordinary realtime serial and high-latency parallel Fanout task times for one to eight independent units per layer, including one or four serial slow requests per worker unit. A separate cost panel uses assumed worker price ratios. This is not a measured Pi or Doubleword comparison.
